sents.zh: 如果没有相关的本地依赖过期，则继续执行步骤 5；除非操作依赖于共享状态版本，否则不需要它们。 4.

sents.en: If the action was READ: a. atomically place the returned material in QUARANTINE_EVIDENCE and advance v_E; b. run CheckAdmissionConflict(o_t, P_active, P_quar) against a consistent snapshot; this check does not depend on a mutation-specific q_m; c.
sents.zh: 如果该操作是 READ：a. 以原子方式将返回的材料放入 QUARANTINE_EVIDENCE 并推进 v_E；b. 针对一致的快照运行 CheckAdmissionConflict(o_t, P_active, P_quar)；该检查不依赖于变更特定的 q_m；c.

paragraphs.en: on CONFLICT or INDETERMINATE, retain the item in quarantine and return QUARANTINE_ONLY, provided the evidence-state version remains the one checked; if it changed, increment retry_count and repeat the admission check against a fresh snapshot, or return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED when the budget is used; d. if no conflict is detected, use compare-and-swap on that checked evidence-state version to atomically remove the item from P_quar, admit it to P_active as UNVERIFIED, and advance v_E; if the compare-and-swap fails, increment retry_count and repeat the check against a fresh snapshot, or return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED when the budget is used; e. do not promote it into P_auth as part of this admission step; return ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED. 5. If the action was STAGE_LOCAL, confirm that no shared-state effects occurred. If confirmed, return STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED; otherwise return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE. 6. If op_t is a REVERSIBLE_WRITE, verify that its authorization permits staging to G_shadow and that the realized effects remain isolated from production, Planner-visible shared identity state, downstream consumers, and P_auth inputs. If so, atomically apply only to G_shadow if v_S still matches sigma_c, advance v_S, and return SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL. If v_S does not match, increment retry_count; if the retry budget is exhausted, return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED; otherwise return RETRY_REEVALUATE and restart Algorithm 1 against a fresh snapshot. If isolation cannot be verified, discard the candidate and return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE; any shared-identity attempt must restart through Algorithm 1 as an IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE. 7. For a protected graph write, apply op_t only to an isolated candidate graph G_cand. 8. Re-derive the required claim set from op_t and the policy in sigma_c. If it differs from the q_m bound in the authorization record, discard the candidate and return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE. 9. Evaluate G_cand against the policy and evidence state in the same sigma_c, using the bound q_m, P_auth(q_m, omega), P_active, P_quar, and the claim-specific conflict check. For each required proposition, verify recorded claim-specific support in P_auth. Map CheckClaimConflict=CONFLICT to BREACH and CheckClaimConflict=INDETERMINATE to UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE; either result blocks PASS. Do not mix in evidence from a later snapshot. 10. If the result is BREACH, discard the candidate and return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE. 11.
paragraphs.zh: 当结果为 CONFLICT 或 INDETERMINATE 时，若已核对的证据状态版本保持不变，则将该条目保留在隔离区并返回 QUARANTINE_ONLY；若该版本已变化，则将 retry_count 加一，并针对新快照重新执行准入检查；若重试预算已用尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED。d. 若未检测到冲突，则对已核对的证据状态版本执行比较并交换操作，以原子方式将该条目从 P_quar 中移除，将其以 UNVERIFIED 状态准入 P_active，并推进 v_E；若比较并交换失败，则将 retry_count 加一，并针对新快照重新执行检查；若重试预算已用尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED。e. 不得在此准入步骤中将其提升至 P_auth；返回 ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED。 5. 若该动作为 STAGE_LOCAL，则确认未发生任何共享状态效应。 若确认无误，则返回 STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED；否则返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE。 6. 若 op_t 是 REVERSIBLE_WRITE，则验证其授权允许暂存到 G_shadow，且所实现的效应与生产环境、对 Planner 可见的共享身份状态、下游消费者以及 P_auth 输入保持隔离。 若满足上述条件，则在 v_S 仍与 sigma_c 匹配时，仅对 G_shadow 原子地应用该操作，推进 v_S，并返回 SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL。 若 v_S 不匹配，则将 retry_count 加一；若重试预算已耗尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED；否则返回 RETRY_REEVALUATE，并针对新快照重新启动算法 1。 若无法验证隔离性，则丢弃候选并返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE；任何共享身份尝试都必须作为 IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE 通过算法 1 重新启动。 7. 对于受保护图的写入，仅将 op_t 应用到隔离的候选图 G_cand 上。 8. 从 op_t 和 sigma_c 中的策略重新推导所需的断言集合。 若其与授权记录中绑定的 q_m 不同，则丢弃候选并返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE。 9. 在同一 sigma_c 下，使用绑定的 q_m、P_auth(q_m, omega)、P_active、P_quar 以及针对断言的冲突检查，依据策略和证据状态评估 G_cand。 对于每个所需命题，验证 P_auth 中记录的针对该断言的支持。 将 CheckClaimConflict=CONFLICT 映射为 BREACH，将 CheckClaimConflict=INDETERMINATE 映射为 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE；任一结果都会阻断 PASS。 不得混入来自更晚快照的证据。 10. 若结果为 BREACH，则丢弃候选并返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE。 11.

sents.en: on CONFLICT or INDETERMINATE, retain the item in quarantine and return QUARANTINE_ONLY, provided the evidence-state version remains the one checked; if it changed, increment retry_count and repeat the admission check against a fresh snapshot, or return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED when the budget is used; d. if no conflict is detected, use compare-and-swap on that checked evidence-state version to atomically remove the item from P_quar, admit it to P_active as UNVERIFIED, and advance v_E; if the compare-and-swap fails, increment retry_count and repeat the check against a fresh snapshot, or return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED when the budget is used; e. do not promote it into P_auth as part of this admission step; return ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED. 5.
sents.zh: 当结果为 CONFLICT 或 INDETERMINATE 时，若已核对的证据状态版本保持不变，则将该条目保留在隔离区并返回 QUARANTINE_ONLY；若该版本已变化，则将 retry_count 加一，并针对新快照重新执行准入检查；若重试预算已用尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED。d. 若未检测到冲突，则对已核对的证据状态版本执行比较并交换操作，以原子方式将该条目从 P_quar 中移除，将其以 UNVERIFIED 状态准入 P_active，并推进 v_E；若比较并交换失败，则将 retry_count 加一，并针对新快照重新执行检查；若重试预算已用尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED。e. 不得在此准入步骤中将其提升至 P_auth；返回 ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED。 5.

sents.en: If the action was STAGE_LOCAL, confirm that no shared-state effects occurred.
sents.zh: 若该动作为 STAGE_LOCAL，则确认未发生任何共享状态效应。

sents.en: If confirmed, return STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED; otherwise return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE. 6.
sents.zh: 若确认无误，则返回 STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED；否则返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE。 6.

sents.en: If op_t is a REVERSIBLE_WRITE, verify that its authorization permits staging to G_shadow and that the realized effects remain isolated from production, Planner-visible shared identity state, downstream consumers, and P_auth inputs.
sents.zh: 若 op_t 是 REVERSIBLE_WRITE，则验证其授权允许暂存到 G_shadow，且所实现的效应与生产环境、对 Planner 可见的共享身份状态、下游消费者以及 P_auth 输入保持隔离。

sents.en: If so, atomically apply only to G_shadow if v_S still matches sigma_c, advance v_S, and return SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL.
sents.zh: 若满足上述条件，则在 v_S 仍与 sigma_c 匹配时，仅对 G_shadow 原子地应用该操作，推进 v_S，并返回 SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL。

sents.en: If v_S does not match, increment retry_count; if the retry budget is exhausted, return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED; otherwise return RETRY_REEVALUATE and restart Algorithm 1 against a fresh snapshot.
sents.zh: 若 v_S 不匹配，则将 retry_count 加一；若重试预算已耗尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED；否则返回 RETRY_REEVALUATE，并针对新快照重新启动算法 1。

sents.en: If isolation cannot be verified, discard the candidate and return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE; any shared-identity attempt must restart through Algorithm 1 as an IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE. 7.
sents.zh: 若无法验证隔离性，则丢弃候选并返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE；任何共享身份尝试都必须作为 IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE 通过算法 1 重新启动。 7.

sents.en: For a protected graph write, apply op_t only to an isolated candidate graph G_cand. 8.
sents.zh: 对于受保护图的写入，仅将 op_t 应用到隔离的候选图 G_cand 上。 8.

sents.en: Re-derive the required claim set from op_t and the policy in sigma_c.
sents.zh: 从 op_t 和 sigma_c 中的策略重新推导所需的断言集合。

sents.en: If it differs from the q_m bound in the authorization record, discard the candidate and return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE. 9.
sents.zh: 若其与授权记录中绑定的 q_m 不同，则丢弃候选并返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE。 9.

sents.en: Evaluate G_cand against the policy and evidence state in the same sigma_c, using the bound q_m, P_auth(q_m, omega), P_active, P_quar, and the claim-specific conflict check.
sents.zh: 在同一 sigma_c 下，使用绑定的 q_m、P_auth(q_m, omega)、P_active、P_quar 以及针对断言的冲突检查，依据策略和证据状态评估 G_cand。

sents.en: For each required proposition, verify recorded claim-specific support in P_auth.
sents.zh: 对于每个所需命题，验证 P_auth 中记录的针对该断言的支持。

sents.en: Map CheckClaimConflict=CONFLICT to BREACH and CheckClaimConflict=INDETERMINATE to UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE; either result blocks PASS.
sents.zh: 将 CheckClaimConflict=CONFLICT 映射为 BREACH，将 CheckClaimConflict=INDETERMINATE 映射为 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE；任一结果都会阻断 PASS。

sents.en: Do not mix in evidence from a later snapshot. 10.
sents.zh: 不得混入来自更晚快照的证据。 10.

sents.en: If the result is BREACH, discard the candidate and return REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE. 11.
sents.zh: 若结果为 BREACH，则丢弃候选并返回 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE。 11.

paragraphs.en: If the result is UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE, do not commit or stage the protected candidate in G_shadow; defer the identity-changing decision. Return HALT_HITL only when policy requires adjudication and a reviewer is available; otherwise return DEFER_UNRESOLVED. 12. If the result is PASS, atomically attempt commit only if the authorized scope remains valid and the current graph version v_G, evidence-state version v_E, policy version v_pol, and shadow version v_S (if used and bound in the authorization record) still match sigma_c at the commit point. On successful commit, advance v_G and return COMMITTED. If atomic version validation fails, handle it as VERSION_CONFLICT under Step 13. A confirmed COMMIT_FAILED with no committed effect is handled under Step 13; an uncertain outcome is handled as TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN. 13. On VERSION_CONFLICT, increment retry_count; if the retry budget is exhausted, return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED, otherwise return RETRY_REEVALUATE and restart Algorithm 1 against a fresh snapshot with a new authorization record. This same retry budget applies to retry triggers in Steps 3 and 6 and to version changes or admission compare-and-swap failures in Step 4; for Step 4, rerun the admission check against a fresh snapshot rather than re-executing the READ action. On TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN, return COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE and freeze until the operation_id outcome is reconciled. On confirmed COMMIT_FAILED, return SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE; do not treat it as a semantic identity verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 若结果为 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE，则不得提交（commit）或暂存（stage）G_shadow 中的受保护候选智能体；将改变身份的决策予以推迟。 仅当策略要求裁定且有审核员可用时才返回 HALT_HITL；否则返回 DEFER_UNRESOLVED。 若结果为 PASS，则仅在授权范围仍然有效，且当前图版本 v_G、证据状态版本 v_E、策略版本 v_pol、影子版本 v_S（如已使用并绑定于授权记录中）在提交点仍与 sigma_c 匹配时，才原子性地尝试提交。 提交成功后，推进 v_G 并返回 COMMITTED。 若原子性版本校验失败，则按第 13 步中的 VERSION_CONFLICT 处理。 已确认的 COMMIT_FAILED 且未产生已提交效果的，按第 13 步处理；结果不确定的，按 TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN 处理。 出现 VERSION_CONFLICT 时，递增 retry_count；若重试预算已耗尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED，否则返回 RETRY_REEVALUATE，并基于新快照和新的授权记录重新启动算法 1。 同一重试预算适用于第 3 步和第 6 步中的重试触发，以及第 4 步中的版本变更或准入比较并交换（compare-and-swap）失败；对于第 4 步，应针对新快照重新运行准入检查，而非重新执行 READ 操作。 出现 TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN 时，返回 COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE 并冻结，直到 operation_id 的结果得到对账。 出现已确认的 COMMIT_FAILED 时，返回 SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE；不要将其视为语义身份判定。

sents.en: If the result is UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE, do not commit or stage the protected candidate in G_shadow; defer the identity-changing decision.
sents.zh: 若结果为 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE，则不得提交（commit）或暂存（stage）G_shadow 中的受保护候选智能体；将改变身份的决策予以推迟。

sents.en: Return HALT_HITL only when policy requires adjudication and a reviewer is available; otherwise return DEFER_UNRESOLVED. 12.
sents.zh: 仅当策略要求裁定且有审核员可用时才返回 HALT_HITL；否则返回 DEFER_UNRESOLVED。

sents.en: If the result is PASS, atomically attempt commit only if the authorized scope remains valid and the current graph version v_G, evidence-state version v_E, policy version v_pol, and shadow version v_S (if used and bound in the authorization record) still match sigma_c at the commit point.
sents.zh: 若结果为 PASS，则仅在授权范围仍然有效，且当前图版本 v_G、证据状态版本 v_E、策略版本 v_pol、影子版本 v_S（如已使用并绑定于授权记录中）在提交点仍与 sigma_c 匹配时，才原子性地尝试提交。

sents.en: On successful commit, advance v_G and return COMMITTED.
sents.zh: 提交成功后，推进 v_G 并返回 COMMITTED。

sents.en: If atomic version validation fails, handle it as VERSION_CONFLICT under Step 13.
sents.zh: 若原子性版本校验失败，则按第 13 步中的 VERSION_CONFLICT 处理。

sents.en: A confirmed COMMIT_FAILED with no committed effect is handled under Step 13; an uncertain outcome is handled as TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN. 13.
sents.zh: 已确认的 COMMIT_FAILED 且未产生已提交效果的，按第 13 步处理；结果不确定的，按 TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN 处理。

sents.en: On VERSION_CONFLICT, increment retry_count; if the retry budget is exhausted, return TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED, otherwise return RETRY_REEVALUATE and restart Algorithm 1 against a fresh snapshot with a new authorization record.
sents.zh: 出现 VERSION_CONFLICT 时，递增 retry_count；若重试预算已耗尽，则返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED，否则返回 RETRY_REEVALUATE，并基于新快照和新的授权记录重新启动算法 1。

sents.en: This same retry budget applies to retry triggers in Steps 3 and 6 and to version changes or admission compare-and-swap failures in Step 4; for Step 4, rerun the admission check against a fresh snapshot rather than re-executing the READ action.
sents.zh: 同一重试预算适用于第 3 步和第 6 步中的重试触发，以及第 4 步中的版本变更或准入比较并交换（compare-and-swap）失败；对于第 4 步，应针对新快照重新运行准入检查，而非重新执行 READ 操作。

sents.en: On TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN, return COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE and freeze until the operation_id outcome is reconciled.
sents.zh: 出现 TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN 时，返回 COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE 并冻结，直到 operation_id 的结果得到对账。

sents.en: On confirmed COMMIT_FAILED, return SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE; do not treat it as a semantic identity verdict.
sents.zh: 出现已确认的 COMMIT_FAILED 时，返回 SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE；不要将其视为语义身份判定。

paragraphs.en: Lifecycle semantics. Pre-execution directives, post-execution outcomes, and case statuses are distinct; the transaction-outcome mapping is defined in Section 6.1. READ_AUTHORIZED and STAGE_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED are pre-execution scope decisions, not validation of content or completed operations. STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED means the local operation completed without shared-state effects. REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION denotes rejection of an unsupported action type; OUT_OF_BAND_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED means execution is withheld pending authorization outside this interface. COMMITTED means that the protected candidate passed commit-time validation and was committed within the authorized scope, with the graph version advanced; it is not a claim of semantic truth beyond the stated policy and evidence assumptions. QUARANTINE_ONLY keeps an observation outside Planner-visible shared evidence pending adjudication; it does not label the item false or malicious. ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED means an item entered P active P_{\mathrm{active}} as UNVERIFIED , not that it became authorization-eligible. SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL means a candidate was staged only in isolated G shadow G_{\mathrm{shadow}} ; it is neither a production commit nor permission to publish and any later production mutation requires a new protected authorization decision. DEFER_UNRESOLVED terminates the current automated attempt but leaves the case available for later review or explicitly authorized retry. HALT_HITL is emitted only when the policy requires human adjudication and a reviewer is available; if no reviewer is available, return DEFER_UNRESOLVED . A human decision may update evidence eligibility or the versioned policy but cannot bypass the invariant; it requires a new authorization decision. RETRY_REEVALUATE requires a fresh snapshot and a new authorization decision. TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED is returned when the common retry budget is exhausted, regardless of which version/snapshot check triggered it; COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE freezes the case until a timeout outcome is reconciled; and SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE reports a confirmed infrastructure failure. These are not semantic verdicts. REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE discards a not-yet-committed candidate; it does not imply rollback of a previously committed mutation. Its destination is a policy-defined adjudication or operations queue; escalation does not itself change evidence eligibility or authorize a retry.
paragraphs.zh: 生命周期语义。 执行前指令、执行后结果与案例状态是相互区分的；事务与结果的映射定义见 6.1 节。 READ_AUTHORIZED 和 STAGE_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED 是执行前的范围决策，并非对内容或已完成操作的验证。 STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED 表示本地操作已完成，且未产生共享状态影响。 REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION 表示拒绝不支持的动作类型；OUT_OF_BAND_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED 表示执行被暂缓，等待本接口之外的授权。 COMMITTED 表示受保护候选通过了提交时验证，并在授权范围内被提交，图版本随之推进；它并不声称超出既定策略与证据假设的语义真实性。 QUARANTINE_ONLY 使一条观察暂存于规划器可见的共享证据之外，等待裁决；它并不将该条目标记为虚假或恶意。 ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED 表示某条目以 UNVERIFIED 状态进入了激活集 P_{\mathrm{active}}，并不代表它已获得授权资格。 SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL 表示候选仅被暂存于隔离的影子图 G_{\mathrm{shadow}}；它既不是生产提交，也不是发布许可，任何后续的生产变更都需要新的受保护授权决策。 DEFER_UNRESOLVED 终止当前自动化尝试，但保留案例以供后续审查或经明确授权的重试。 仅当策略要求人工裁决且有审查者可用时才发出 HALT_HITL；若无审查者可用，则返回 DEFER_UNRESOLVED。 人工决策可以更新证据资格或带版本的策略，但不能绕过不变量；它需要新的授权决策。 RETRY_REEVALUATE 要求全新的快照和新的授权决策。 当公共重试预算耗尽时返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED，无论是由哪个版本/快照检查触发的；COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE 会冻结案例，直到超时结果得到对账；SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE 则报告已确认的基础设施故障。 这些都不是语义裁决。 REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE 会丢弃尚未提交的候选；它并不意味回滚之前已提交的变更。 其去向是策略定义的裁决或运维队列；升级本身不会改变证据资格，也不会授权重试。

sents.en: Lifecycle semantics.
sents.zh: 生命周期语义。

sents.en: Pre-execution directives, post-execution outcomes, and case statuses are distinct; the transaction-outcome mapping is defined in Section 6.1.
sents.zh: 执行前指令、执行后结果与案例状态是相互区分的；事务与结果的映射定义见 6.1 节。

sents.en: READ_AUTHORIZED and STAGE_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED are pre-execution scope decisions, not validation of content or completed operations.
sents.zh: READ_AUTHORIZED 和 STAGE_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED 是执行前的范围决策，并非对内容或已完成操作的验证。

sents.en: STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED means the local operation completed without shared-state effects.
sents.zh: STAGE_LOCAL_CONFIRMED 表示本地操作已完成，且未产生共享状态影响。

sents.en: REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION denotes rejection of an unsupported action type; OUT_OF_BAND_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED means execution is withheld pending authorization outside this interface.
sents.zh: REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION 表示拒绝不支持的动作类型；OUT_OF_BAND_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED 表示执行被暂缓，等待本接口之外的授权。

sents.en: COMMITTED means that the protected candidate passed commit-time validation and was committed within the authorized scope, with the graph version advanced; it is not a claim of semantic truth beyond the stated policy and evidence assumptions.
sents.zh: COMMITTED 表示受保护候选通过了提交时验证，并在授权范围内被提交，图版本随之推进；它并不声称超出既定策略与证据假设的语义真实性。

sents.en: QUARANTINE_ONLY keeps an observation outside Planner-visible shared evidence pending adjudication; it does not label the item false or malicious.
sents.zh: QUARANTINE_ONLY 使一条观察暂存于规划器可见的共享证据之外，等待裁决；它并不将该条目标记为虚假或恶意。

sents.en: ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED means an item entered P active P_{\mathrm{active}} as UNVERIFIED , not that it became authorization-eligible.
sents.zh: ADMIT_EVIDENCE_COMMITTED 表示某条目以 UNVERIFIED 状态进入了激活集 P_{\mathrm{active}}，并不代表它已获得授权资格。

sents.en: SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL means a candidate was staged only in isolated G shadow G_{\mathrm{shadow}} ; it is neither a production commit nor permission to publish and any later production mutation requires a new protected authorization decision.
sents.zh: SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL 表示候选仅被暂存于隔离的影子图 G_{\mathrm{shadow}}；它既不是生产提交，也不是发布许可，任何后续的生产变更都需要新的受保护授权决策。

sents.en: DEFER_UNRESOLVED terminates the current automated attempt but leaves the case available for later review or explicitly authorized retry.
sents.zh: DEFER_UNRESOLVED 终止当前自动化尝试，但保留案例以供后续审查或经明确授权的重试。

sents.en: HALT_HITL is emitted only when the policy requires human adjudication and a reviewer is available; if no reviewer is available, return DEFER_UNRESOLVED .
sents.zh: 仅当策略要求人工裁决且有审查者可用时才发出 HALT_HITL；若无审查者可用，则返回 DEFER_UNRESOLVED。

sents.en: A human decision may update evidence eligibility or the versioned policy but cannot bypass the invariant; it requires a new authorization decision.
sents.zh: 人工决策可以更新证据资格或带版本的策略，但不能绕过不变量；它需要新的授权决策。

sents.en: RETRY_REEVALUATE requires a fresh snapshot and a new authorization decision.
sents.zh: RETRY_REEVALUATE 要求全新的快照和新的授权决策。

sents.en: TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED is returned when the common retry budget is exhausted, regardless of which version/snapshot check triggered it; COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE freezes the case until a timeout outcome is reconciled; and SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE reports a confirmed infrastructure failure.
sents.zh: 当公共重试预算耗尽时返回 TRANSACTION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED，无论是由哪个版本/快照检查触发的；COMMIT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILE 会冻结案例，直到超时结果得到对账；SYSTEM_FAILURE_ESCALATE 则报告已确认的基础设施故障。

sents.en: These are not semantic verdicts.
sents.zh: 这些都不是语义裁决。

sents.en: REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE discards a not-yet-committed candidate; it does not imply rollback of a previously committed mutation.
sents.zh: REJECT_CANDIDATE_AND_ESCALATE 会丢弃尚未提交的候选；它并不意味回滚之前已提交的变更。

sents.en: Its destination is a policy-defined adjudication or operations queue; escalation does not itself change evidence eligibility or authorize a retry.
sents.zh: 其去向是策略定义的裁决或运维队列；升级本身不会改变证据资格，也不会授权重试。

paragraphs.en: SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL applies only to an explicitly authorized REVERSIBLE_WRITE under the Section 6.1 isolation conditions, not to a protected candidate deferred as UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE .
paragraphs.zh: SHADOW_STAGED_PROVISIONAL 仅适用于在第 6.1 节隔离条件下被明确授权的 REVERSIBLE_WRITE，不适用于被搁置为 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE 的受保护候选对象。

paragraphs.en: The claimed property is limited to the protected persistence boundary: UNVERIFIED evidence is not eligible to satisfy positive authorization conditions unless and until it is separately promoted for the specific claim under the stated contract. Evidence may still influence the Planner, and the interface does not establish that every bad claim or material conflict will be recognized, that provenance assertions are truthful, or that the agent’s internal state remains uncontaminated.
paragraphs.zh: 所主张的属性仅限于受保护的持久化边界内：未经核实的证据不符合满足正向授权条件的资格，除非且直到其按照所述合同针对特定声明被单独提升。 证据仍可能影响规划器，且该接口并不证明每一个错误声明或实质性冲突都会被识别、来源断言是真实的、或智能体的内部状态保持不受污染。

paragraphs.en: An Agentic ER system is resolving the legal entity Acme Global , which has acquired BetaTech . A separate startup, Acme AI, Inc. , operates in a related technical sector. Acme Cloud is a brand of Acme Global ( Acme Cloud brand_of Acme Global ). Distributed evidence includes legal records, CRM entries, and noisy media reports that conflate Acme Cloud with Acme AI, Inc. because of lexical overlap.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体式实体消解系统正在解析法律实体 Acme Global，该实体已收购了 BetaTech。 另一家独立初创公司 Acme AI, Inc. 在相关技术领域运营。 Acme Cloud 是 Acme Global 的一个品牌（Acme Cloud brand_of Acme Global）。 分布式证据包括法律记录、CRM 条目，以及因词汇重叠而将 Acme Cloud 与 Acme AI, Inc. 混淆的嘈杂媒体报道。

paragraphs.en: same_legal_entity : an identity-equivalence relation subject to claim-specific authorization;
paragraphs.zh: same_legal_entity : 一种受权利要求特定授权约束的同一性等价关系；

paragraphs.en: renamed_to : continuity of the same legal entity over time, subject to temporal validity;
paragraphs.zh: renamed_to : 同一法律实体随时间的延续性，需满足时间有效性；

paragraphs.en: brand_of : a brand-to-legal-entity relation that does not authorize identity merge;
paragraphs.zh: brand_of ：一种从品牌到法律实体的关系，不授权进行身份合并；

paragraphs.en: absorbed_by : an acquisition relation that does not by itself establish same_legal_entity or legal continuity. It is a non-sufficient relation, not by itself a prohibitive finding that the identity claim is false; absent sufficient continuity evidence the result is UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE , while BREACH requires separate authorized evidence or an explicit policy condition establishing a contradiction.
paragraphs.zh: absorbed_by：一种收购关系，其本身不足以确立 same_legal_entity 或法律上的连续性。 它是一个非充分关系，其本身并不构成对身份主张为假的禁止性认定；在缺乏足够的连续性证据时，结果为 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE，而判定 BREACH 则需要单独的授权证据，或某一明确政策条件确立的矛盾。

paragraphs.en: Legal Lineage Constraint. Distinct representations may be merged through an IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE only when authorization-eligible evidence establishes the required same_legal_entity condition or applicable legal continuity through renamed_to . A temporally valid Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) can provide relevant legal-entity evidence [27, 28], but the existence of an LEI does not by itself prove that a particular mention belongs to its holder. A brand relation or acquisition edge alone does not establish that two entities are identical.
paragraphs.zh: 法律谱系约束。 仅当具备授权资格的证据确立了所需的 same_legal_entity 条件，或通过 renamed_to 确立了适用的法律连续性时，才可通过 IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE 合并不同的表示。 时间上有效的法人识别码（LEI）可以提供相关的法人证据 [27, 28]，但 LEI 的存在本身并不能证明某个特定提及属于其持有者。 仅凭品牌关系或收购边并不能确立两个实体是同一实体。

paragraphs.en: An unconstrained agent identifies lexical or semantic similarity between Acme Cloud and Acme AI, Inc. A retrieval step returns a speculative blog post discussing a commercial partnership. A naive matcher treats evidence of a partnership involving the Acme Cloud brand as evidence of referential identity and concludes that Acme AI, Inc. is identical to Acme Cloud. It then propagates the mistaken equivalence to Acme Global. This is an illustrative Merge Failure and Contextual Displacement under the DIO/ODI distinctions [7, 19].
paragraphs.zh: 一个不受约束的智能体识别出 Acme Cloud 与 Acme AI, Inc. 之间的词汇或语义相似性。 检索步骤返回一篇推测性的博客文章，其中讨论了一项商业合作。 一个朴素的匹配器将涉及 Acme Cloud 品牌的合作证据当作指称同一性的证据，并得出 Acme AI, Inc. 与 Acme Cloud 是同一实体的结论。 随后它将这一错误的等价关系传播到 Acme Global。 这是 DIO/ODI 区分下[7, 19]的一个说明性的合并失败与语境错位示例。

sents.en: An unconstrained agent identifies lexical or semantic similarity between Acme Cloud and Acme AI, Inc.
sents.zh: 一个不受约束的智能体识别出 Acme Cloud 与 Acme AI, Inc. 之间的词汇或语义相似性。

paragraphs.en: For this example, assume that P auth P_{\mathrm{auth}} contains no claim-specific evidence establishing same_legal_entity or an applicable renamed_to continuity claim between the two candidate referents. The speculative partnership post is available only as UNVERIFIED context, and no authorization-eligible evidence independently establishes the required identity proposition. The brand and partnership relations therefore cannot satisfy the positive condition; the graph evaluation returns UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE , and the irreversible merge is deferred. If claim-specific authorized evidence instead established that the two legal entities were distinct, the result would be BREACH . This is an illustration of the commit-boundary property, not evidence that all variants of apparent verification will be intercepted.
paragraphs.zh: 在本示例中，假设 P auth P_{\mathrm{auth}} 不包含能够确立两个候选指称对象之间存在 same_legal_entity 或适用的 renamed_to 延续性声明的、针对具体声明的证据。 关于合作关系的推测性帖子仅可作为 UNVERIFIED 上下文使用，且没有任何具备授权资格的证据独立地确立所需的同一性命题。 因此，品牌关系和合作关系无法满足肯定性条件；图谱评估返回 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE，不可逆的合并被推迟。 反之，如果针对具体声明的已授权证据确立了这两个法律实体是不同的，则结果将为 BREACH。 这是对提交边界特性的一个说明，而并非表明所有看似已验证的变体都会被拦截的证据。

paragraphs.en: Hypothesis-conditioned accumulation. Suppose the same mistaken hypothesis also prompts searches of a trade directory and a news index. Three returned items appear to reinforce the proposed merge, but their recorded provenance links lead back to the same promotional announcement and none independently establishes same_legal_entity or valid legal continuity. The items may be admitted as UNVERIFIED observations, but their number and apparent agreement do not make them three independent grounds for promotion. Under promotion-contract items 3–4, they remain ineligible as positive identity support unless the declared policy accepts a separately recorded, claim-specific basis. The case therefore remains UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE and is deferred. This example tests the recorded-provenance restriction in the promotion contract; if the relevant derivation links are absent from the record, the architecture does not guarantee that the dependency will be detected.
paragraphs.zh: 假设条件下的累积。 假设同一个错误假设还引发了对贸易名录和新闻索引的检索。 三条返回条目看似支持所提议的合并，但它们记录的来源链接都指向同一条宣传公告，且没有任何一条独立地确立 same_legal_entity 或有效的法律延续性。 这些条目可以被接纳为 UNVERIFIED 观察结果，但它们的数量和表面上的相互一致并不能使它们成为支持晋升的三个独立依据。 根据晋升契约第 3–4 条，除非声明的政策接受单独记录的、针对具体主张的依据，否则它们仍不符合作为正面身份支持的资格。 因此该案例仍保持 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE 状态并被延后处理。 本示例检验晋升契约中的记录来源限制；如果记录中缺少相关的推导链接，该架构不保证能够检测到这一依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Consider a second hypothetical case involving a source-local supplier key, SUP-041 . A source’s change log shows that the key was assigned to Supplier A during one validity interval, retired, and later reassigned to unrelated Supplier B. A flat rule that treats equality of this source-local identifier as sufficient identity evidence would merge the records despite their non-overlapping assignments. A TRF-informed constraint treats the identifier as temporally scoped: equality outside the same valid assignment interval cannot satisfy the identity proposition. If the reassignment record is authorization-eligible and establishes different assignments, evaluation returns BREACH ; if the interval or assignment remains unresolved, it returns UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE . Neither outcome authorizes the merge.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑第二个假设案例，其中涉及一个来源本地供应商键 SUP-041 。 该来源的变更日志显示，此键在某个有效期区间内被分配给供应商A，随后被停用，后来又被重新分配给无关的供应商B。 若采用简单规则，将此来源本地标识符的相等视为充分的身份证据，那么即使两次分配在时间上不重叠，记录也会被合并。 基于 TRF 的约束将此标识符视为具有时间作用域：在相同有效分配区间之外的相等无法满足身份命题。 如果重新分配记录具备授权资格且确立了不同的分配，评估将返回 BREACH ；如果区间或分配仍未解决，则返回 UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE 。 这两种结果都不会授权执行合并。

sents.en: Neither outcome authorizes the merge.
sents.zh: 这两种结果都不会授权执行合并。

paragraphs.en: This example distinguishes a temporally typed constraint from a flat identifier-equality rule , not from a competent baseline that already encodes the same validity intervals. It illustrates how a DIO/ODI diagnostic can make an identity-preserving condition explicit; it does not demonstrate empirical superiority over well-designed temporal entity resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 该示例将一个基于时间类型的约束与一个扁平的标识符相等规则区分开来，而不是与一个已经编码了相同有效性区间的、能力相当的基线进行比较。 它说明了 DIO/ODI 诊断如何使一个保持同一性的条件变得显式；它并未证明其在经验上优于设计良好的时序实体消解方法。

paragraphs.en: Consider a paired hypothetical case in which two records have different names because the same legal entity was formally renamed. If appropriate legal records establish the continuity claim for the relevant time interval, and claim-specific evidence satisfies the configured constraints, the guardrail may return PASS and permit the authorized resolution. If the available record merely establishes a commercial acquisition or brand relationship, that is insufficient. The contrast illustrates that the policy is not a blanket rule rejecting every uncertain match; it is a typed mapping between the relationship asserted, the evidence available, and the mutation requested.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个成对的假设情形：两条记录的名称不同，原因是同一法律实体经过正式更名。 如果适当的法律记录能够证实相关时间区间内的连续性主张，且特定于该主张的证据满足已配置的约束条件，则该护栏可能返回 PASS 并允许该经授权的解析操作。 如果可用记录仅仅证明了商业收购或品牌关系，那是不够的。 这一对比说明，该策略并非一概拒绝所有不确定匹配的笼统规则；它是「所主张的关系、可用的证据与所请求的变更」三者之间的一种类型化映射。

paragraphs.en: This section proposes an evaluation plan for future empirical validation. No experimental results are claimed. The central question is whether DIO/ODI-informed mutation constraints improve the safety/coverage trade-off beyond generic authorization controls and conventional identifier rules, under comparable resources.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提出了一个用于未来实证验证的评估计划。 本工作未声称有任何实验结果。 核心问题在于：在资源相当的前提下，基于 DIO/ODI 的变异约束能否在通用授权控制和传统标识符规则之外，进一步改进安全性/覆盖率的权衡。

sents.en: This section proposes an evaluation plan for future empirical validation.
sents.zh: 本节提出了一个用于未来实证验证的评估计划。

sents.en: No experimental results are claimed.
sents.zh: 本工作未声称有任何实验结果。

sents.en: The central question is whether DIO/ODI-informed mutation constraints improve the safety/coverage trade-off beyond generic authorization controls and conventional identifier rules, under comparable resources.
sents.zh: 核心问题在于：在资源相当的前提下，基于 DIO/ODI 的变异约束能否在通用授权控制和传统标识符规则之外，进一步改进安全性/覆盖率的权衡。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation should compare at least four conditions:
paragraphs.zh: 评估应至少比较四种条件：

paragraphs.en: Baseline A — Unconstrained Agentic ER: a documented agent using retrieval tools and an ER matcher without the proposed mutation-authorization boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 基线 A — 无约束智能体 ER：一个使用检索工具和 ER 匹配器的有据可查的智能体，但不包含所提出的变更授权边界。

paragraphs.en: Baseline B — Conventional identifier/default-deny rules: the same task with standard identifier constraints and abstention when required evidence is missing.
paragraphs.zh: 基线 B — 常规标识符/默认拒绝规则：同一任务采用标准标识符约束，并在所需证据缺失时弃答。

paragraphs.en: Baseline C — Generic authorization boundary: the same two-phase mutation gate and claim-specific evidence separation, but with conventional policy rules authored without the DIO/ODI diagnostic mapping.
paragraphs.zh: Baseline C — 通用授权边界：采用相同的两阶段变更门控与特定于声明的证据分离，但使用常规策略规则编写，不包含 DIO/ODI 诊断映射。

paragraphs.en: Challenger — DIO/ODI-informed guardrail: the same gate, evidence-promotion process, validator class, domain facts, and resource budget as C, with those same prespecified domain facts organized into the proposed mapping from referential, semantic, temporal, and contextual failure distinctions to mutation-specific constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战者（Challenger）——基于 DIO/ODI 的护栏：与 C 使用相同的门控、证据提升流程、验证器类别、领域事实和资源预算，并将这些相同的预指定领域事实组织到所提议的映射中，即从指涉性、语义、时间性和情境性故障区分到特定变异约束的映射。

paragraphs.en: Baseline C and the Challenger must use the same case inventory, underlying domain-fact annotations, evidence-promotion process and validator class, action resources, and decision budget. The policies should be authored independently from a shared fact inventory, so that the Challenger is not advantaged by receiving facts withheld from C. Authoring effort, available time, and relevant ER/policy expertise should be matched as far as practicable; authors should not see the counterpart policy or its results before their versions are frozen, and any adjudication process should be prespecified. This comparison remains sensitive to policy-authoring skill: with one author or team per condition, observed differences would conflate the diagnostic organization with the authors’ expertise. Replication across independent author teams would help assess that source of variation, but is not a prerequisite for defining the conceptual protocol. Before running the evaluation, prespecify strata expected to be diagnostic for the mapping, including temporally reused source-local identifiers, relations that are relevant in one context but insufficient for identity in another, and hypothesis-conditioned cases where multiple UNVERIFIED observations appear mutually reinforcing but their recorded provenance links indicate shared upstream origins. If Baseline C independently encodes the same constraints from the same facts, identical outcomes are expected and do not count as evidence of a DIO/ODI advantage. The intended difference is the diagnostic structure and its explicit mapping to constraints, not a larger information budget. These comparisons separate default-deny, generic authorization, transaction protection, and DIO/ODI-informed binding. If an orchestration framework such as LangGraph is used, its exact release or commit and relevant configuration should be reported [14].
paragraphs.zh: 基线 C 与挑战者必须使用相同的案例清单、底层领域事实标注、证据提升流程与验证器类别、动作资源以及决策预算。 各策略应基于共享的事实清单独立编写，以避免挑战者因获得 C 未被提供的事实而占优。 编写投入、可用时间以及相关的实体解析/策略专业知识应尽可能匹配；作者在其版本冻结之前不应查看对方策略或其结果，任何裁决流程都应预先规定。 该比较仍对策略编写技能敏感：若每个条件仅由一名作者或一个团队负责，所观察到的差异将把诊断性组织与作者的专业知识混为一谈。 由独立的作者团队进行复制将有助于评估这一变异来源，但这并非定义概念性协议的先决条件。 在运行评估之前，应预先规定预期对映射具有诊断性的分层，包括在时间上被复用的源本地标识符、在某一上下文中相关但在另一上下文中不足以确定同一性的关系，以及多条例未经验证（UNVERIFIED）的观察结果看似相互印证但其记录的溯源链接表明它们共享同一上游来源的假设条件案例。 如果基线 C 从相同事实中独立编码了相同的约束，则应预期得到相同的结果，且这不算作 DIO/ODI 优势的证据。 预期的差异在于诊断性结构及其到约束的显式映射，而不是更大的信息预算。 这些比较区分了默认拒绝、通用授权、事务保护以及基于 DIO/ODI 的绑定。 如果使用了诸如 LangGraph 之类的编排框架，应报告其确切的版本发布或提交以及相关配置 [14]。

paragraphs.en: The corpus should combine entity-resolution benchmarks with temporally evolving and ambiguous entities where licensing and annotation provenance permit reproducible use. Entity-overshadowing methods provide one source of inspiration [19], while TempEL provides a temporal-evolution setting [25]. Retrieval-augmented generation vulnerability research may inform future perturbation design [24]. The selected datasets, versions, licences, entity identifiers, and ground-truth policies must be documented in the experiment report.
paragraphs.zh: 语料库应在许可协议和标注来源允许可复现使用的前提下，将实体消解基准与具有时间演化性和歧义性的实体相结合。 实体遮蔽方法提供了一个灵感来源 [19]，而 TempEL 提供了一个时间演化场景 [25]。 检索增强生成漏洞研究或可为未来的扰动设计提供参考 [24]。 所选数据集、版本、许可证、实体标识符和真值策略必须在实验报告中予以记录。

sents.zh: 语料库应在许可协议和标注来源允许可复现使用的前提下，将实体消解基准与具有时间演化性和歧义性的实体相结合。

sents.zh: 实体遮蔽方法提供了一个灵感来源 [19]，而 TempEL 提供了一个时间演化场景 [25]。

sents.zh: 检索增强生成漏洞研究或可为未来的扰动设计提供参考 [24]。

sents.en: The selected datasets, versions, licences, entity identifiers, and ground-truth policies must be documented in the experiment report.
sents.zh: 所选数据集、版本、许可证、实体标识符和真值策略必须在实验报告中予以记录。

paragraphs.en: The commit-boundary test set should contain: (i) cases where names, brands, acquisitions, or partnerships are insufficient to establish identity; (ii) positive identity-continuity cases supported by temporally applicable evidence; (iii) conflicting or stale evidence, including source-local identifier reassignment; and (iv) cases in which mention-to-identifier linkage is uncertain. Annotation must separately label (a) whether a mutation is permitted by the predeclared domain policy and (b) whether it is referentially correct according to independent ground truth. Threshold selection and model configuration must be separated from the final test split. Entity-disjoint and perturbation-template-disjoint splits should be used where feasible.
paragraphs.zh: 提交边界测试集应包含：(i) 名称、品牌、收购或合作关系不足以确立同一性的案例；(ii) 有时间上适用的证据支持的肯定性身份连续性案例；(iii) 冲突的或过时的证据，包括源本地标识符重新分配；以及 (iv) 提及到标识符的关联不确定的案例。 标注必须分别标记 (a) 一次变更是否被预先声明的领域策略所允许，以及 (b) 该变更根据独立的基准真值是否在指称上正确。 阈值选择和模型配置必须与最终测试集划分相分离。 在可行的情况下，应使用实体不相交和扰动模板不相交的划分。

sents.en: The commit-boundary test set should contain: (i) cases where names, brands, acquisitions, or partnerships are insufficient to establish identity; (ii) positive identity-continuity cases supported by temporally applicable evidence; (iii) conflicting or stale evidence, including source-local identifier reassignment; and (iv) cases in which mention-to-identifier linkage is uncertain.
sents.zh: 提交边界测试集应包含：(i) 名称、品牌、收购或合作关系不足以确立同一性的案例；(ii) 有时间上适用的证据支持的肯定性身份连续性案例；(iii) 冲突的或过时的证据，包括源本地标识符重新分配；以及 (iv) 提及到标识符的关联不确定的案例。

sents.en: Annotation must separately label (a) whether a mutation is permitted by the predeclared domain policy and (b) whether it is referentially correct according to independent ground truth.
sents.zh: 标注必须分别标记 (a) 一次变更是否被预先声明的领域策略所允许，以及 (b) 该变更根据独立的基准真值是否在指称上正确。

sents.en: Threshold selection and model configuration must be separated from the final test split.
sents.zh: 阈值选择和模型配置必须与最终测试集划分相分离。

sents.en: Entity-disjoint and perturbation-template-disjoint splits should be used where feasible.
sents.zh: 在可行的情况下，应使用实体不相交和扰动模板不相交的划分。

paragraphs.en: Concurrency tests should use shared versioned evidence and graph state under controlled workloads. They should measure stale-authorization commits, version-conflict retries, uncertain-commit reconciliation, and whether any candidate is applied after its assumed graph, evidence content, authorization eligibility, or policy context has changed. The promotion process and its version must be held constant between Baseline C and the Challenger; outcomes should also be stratified by whether an error arose from policy specification, evidence promotion, conflict handling, or enforcement/version control.
paragraphs.zh: 并发测试应在受控工作负载下使用共享的带版本证据和图状态。 它们应测量过时授权提交、版本冲突重试、不确定提交的对账，以及是否在任何候选所假设的图、证据内容、授权资格或策略上下文已发生变化之后该候选仍被应用。 晋升流程及其版本在基线 C 与挑战者之间必须保持不变；结果还应按错误源于策略规范、证据晋升、冲突处理还是执行/版本控制进行分层。

sents.en: Concurrency tests should use shared versioned evidence and graph state under controlled workloads.
sents.zh: 并发测试应在受控工作负载下使用共享的带版本证据和图状态。

sents.en: They should measure stale-authorization commits, version-conflict retries, uncertain-commit reconciliation, and whether any candidate is applied after its assumed graph, evidence content, authorization eligibility, or policy context has changed.
sents.zh: 它们应测量过时授权提交、版本冲突重试、不确定提交的对账，以及是否在任何候选所假设的图、证据内容、授权资格或策略上下文已发生变化之后该候选仍被应用。

sents.en: The promotion process and its version must be held constant between Baseline C and the Challenger; outcomes should also be stratified by whether an error arose from policy specification, evidence promotion, conflict handling, or enforcement/version control.
sents.zh: 晋升流程及其版本在基线 C 与挑战者之间必须保持不变；结果还应按错误源于策略规范、证据晋升、冲突处理还是执行/版本控制进行分层。

paragraphs.en: Metrics should jointly report unsafe persistence, resolution coverage, abstention, and operational cost. A single safety metric is insufficient because a system that defers every case could appear safe while offering little useful resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 指标应共同报告不安全持久化、解决覆盖率、弃答率和运营成本。 单一的安全指标是不够的，因为一个对所有案例都弃答的系统可能显得安全，却几乎提供不了任何有用的解决。

sents.en: Metrics should jointly report unsafe persistence, resolution coverage, abstention, and operational cost.
sents.zh: 指标应共同报告不安全持久化、解决覆盖率、弃答率和运营成本。

sents.en: A single safety metric is insufficient because a system that defers every case could appear safe while offering little useful resolution.
sents.zh: 单一的安全指标是不够的，因为一个对所有案例都弃答的系统可能显得安全，却几乎提供不了任何有用的解决。

paragraphs.en: Policy-Enforcement Violation Rate (PEVR). Report protected mutations that were committed despite a failed authorization condition, unresolved required conflict, invalid scope, or stale bound version, divided by all attempted protected mutations. This measures enforcement fidelity to the stated contract; the raw numerator and denominator must also be reported. If there are no attempts, the rate is undefined .
paragraphs.zh: 策略执行违例率（PEVR）。 报告在授权条件未通过、必需冲突未解决、作用域无效或绑定版本过期的情况下仍被提交的受保护变更数量，除以所有尝试的受保护变更总数。 该指标衡量对既定契约的执行保真度；同时必须报告原始的分子和分母。 如果没有任何尝试，则该比率未定义。

sents.en: Policy-Enforcement Violation Rate (PEVR).
sents.zh: 策略执行违例率（PEVR）。

sents.en: Report protected mutations that were committed despite a failed authorization condition, unresolved required conflict, invalid scope, or stale bound version, divided by all attempted protected mutations.
sents.zh: 报告在授权条件未通过、必需冲突未解决、作用域无效或绑定版本过期的情况下仍被提交的受保护变更数量，除以所有尝试的受保护变更总数。

sents.en: This measures enforcement fidelity to the stated contract; the raw numerator and denominator must also be reported.
sents.zh: 该指标衡量对既定契约的执行保真度；同时必须报告原始的分子和分母。

sents.en: If there are no attempts, the rate is undefined .
sents.zh: 如果没有任何尝试，则该比率未定义。

paragraphs.en: Referentially False Commit Rate (RFCR). Report referentially false identity-changing commits, as determined by independent ground-truth annotation, divided by all committed identity-changing mutations. Also report the count of false commits per attempted protected mutation. This measures the combined effect of policy adequacy, promotion quality, and enforcement; it must not be interpreted as an enforcement-only metric. If no identity-changing mutation is committed, RFCR is undefined .

paragraphs.en: Evaluation should report uncertainty across repeated runs and relevant dataset splits. Component ablations should compare conventional rules, the generic authorization gate, and the DIO/ODI-informed binding without bundling all controls into one intervention. The incremental-value hypothesis for the mapping is not supported if, under matched information and resources, the Challenger neither lowers RFCR at comparable safe-resolution coverage nor improves coverage without a material increase in RFCR relative to Baseline C, within the prespecified uncertainty analysis. A result in which C matches or Pareto-dominates the Challenger would count against the proposed incremental value for this task and policy family, not refute DIO/ODI as a broader framework. Any evaluation of dependency-aware cascade mitigation belongs to future research and must be reported separately from this commit-boundary evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 评估应报告多次重复运行及相关数据集划分下的不确定性。 组件消融实验应分别比较传统规则、通用授权门控，以及基于 DIO/ODI 的绑定，而不应将所有控制手段捆绑为单一干预。 如果在信息与资源对等的条件下，在预先设定的不确定性分析范围内，挑战者既未在同等安全解决覆盖率下降低 RFCR，也未在不显著增加 RFCR 的情况下提升覆盖率，则该映射的增量价值假设不成立。 如果 C 与挑战者相当或对其形成帕累托占优，这一结果将反驳本任务与策略族所提出的增量价值，但并不推翻 DIO/ODI 作为更广泛框架的地位。 任何针对依赖感知级联缓解的评估均属于未来研究范畴，且必须与本提交边界评估分开报告。

paragraphs.en: The single evidence-state version v E v_{E} is a deliberately conservative invalidation mechanism: a change to evidence unrelated to a particular q m q_{m} can invalidate a pending authorization and increase retries under contention. The design does not claim starvation-freedom or optimal concurrency. Because unresolved conflicts indicated by quarantined or UNVERIFIED items can defer an otherwise legitimate mutation, noisy or adversarial inputs may impede progress; abuse-resistant prioritization and adjudication are outside the present contract. Revoking evidence promotion invalidates pending authorizations, but does not retroactively undo completed commits; auditing dependent commits and deciding whether compensating mutations are warranted are outside this paper’s scope. The proposed C-versus-Challenger comparison is also sensitive to policy-authoring skill, as discussed in Section 8.1; a single author or team per condition cannot isolate the diagnostic mapping from differences in author expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 单一证据状态版本 v_E 是一种刻意保守的失效机制：与某个特定 q_m 无关的证据变更也可能使待授权失效，并在竞争下增加重试次数。 该设计并不声称免于饥饿或达到最优并发。 由于被隔离或 UNVERIFIED 项所指示的未决冲突可能推迟原本合法的变更，嘈杂或对抗性输入可能阻碍进展；抗滥用的优先级排序与裁决不在本契约的范围之内。 撤销证据晋升会使待授权失效，但不会追溯地撤销已完成的提交；审计依赖这些提交的内容并决定是否需要补偿性变更，不在本文的讨论范围之内。 所提出的 C 与 Challenger 的比较也对策略编写技能敏感，正如第 8.1 节所讨论的；每个条件下仅由单一作者或团队无法将诊断映射与作者专长的差异相分离。

paragraphs.en: The principal limitation is deliberate: the proposed boundary does not prevent an agent from retaining a mistaken hypothesis or from selecting later retrieval actions under its influence. A future dependency-aware architecture could track high-level derivation lineage among hypotheses, actions/queries, observations, and subsequent claims; distinguish multiple documents from genuinely independent corroboration; and expose material dependency information to later planning. Its key test would be whether it reduces unsafe mutation proposals or improves calibrated deferral under controlled hypothesis-conditioned perturbations, without causing disproportionate unwarranted abstention. The present paper does not specify an estimator or claim that such a layer is straightforward to implement.
paragraphs.zh: 主要局限性是有意为之的：所提出的边界并不阻止智能体保留错误的假设，也不阻止其在后续检索动作的选择中受其影响。 未来的依赖感知架构可以追踪假设、动作/查询、观察结果以及后续论断之间的高层派生谱系；区分多份文档与真正独立的佐证；并将实质性依赖信息暴露给后续规划。 其关键检验将在于：在受控的假设条件化扰动下，它是否能减少不安全的修改提议，或改善经过校准的延后处理，同时不会造成不成比例的无理由弃权。 本文并未规定具体的估计器，也未声称这样的层易于实现。

paragraphs.en: The proposal assumes that domain-configured identity-preserving constraints V E V_{E} can be supplied for an entity class and observation domain [6]. In closed enterprise environments, some constraints may be instantiated from schema or identity-management rules [12, 13]. In open-world settings, deciding which properties preserve identity across contexts and time remains difficult. Methods such as Topological Data Analysis are one possible research direction, but their suitability for deriving such constraints from unstructured text has not been established here.
paragraphs.zh: 该提案假设可以为某一实体类和观测领域提供领域配置的保持身份的约束 V E V_{E} [6]。 在封闭的企业环境中，某些约束可以基于模式或身份管理规则进行实例化 [12, 13]。 在开放世界环境中，决定哪些属性在跨上下文和跨时间的情况下保持身份仍然很困难。 诸如拓扑数据分析之类的方法是一个可能的研究方向，但它们对于从非结构化文本中推导此类约束的适用性尚未在此得到证实。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent environments may contain agents operating in different observation domains Ω A ≠ Ω B \Omega_{A}\neq\Omega_{B} , producing legitimate context-specific reconstructions that differ without either necessarily being erroneous [6, 11, 18, 22]. A shared representation does not imply that every agent should produce an identical contextual reconstruction. Future work should develop protocols for sharing versioned evidence while preserving legitimate context-specific outputs and identifying genuine semantic fragmentation. The commit-boundary design addresses a class of persistence and write-contention risks; it does not resolve semantic disagreement among agents by itself.

sents.zh: 未来的工作应制定协议，在共享版本化证据的同时保留合法的情境特定输出，并识别真正的语义碎片化。

sents.en: The commit-boundary design addresses a class of persistence and write-contention risks; it does not resolve semantic disagreement among agents by itself.
sents.zh: 提交边界设计解决了一类持久化和写入竞争风险；它本身并不能解决智能体之间的语义分歧。

paragraphs.en: Agentic ER enables iterative evidence acquisition and state updates, but an early identity hypothesis may influence later retrieval and create apparent confirmation. This paper deliberately does not claim to eliminate that feedback mechanism. It proposes a narrower architectural contribution: a DIO/ODI-informed boundary between evidence available to an agent for reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize a persistent identity-changing mutation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化 ER 支持迭代式的证据获取与状态更新，但早期的身份假设可能会影响后续检索并造成表面上的确认。 本文刻意不声称能消除该反馈机制。 它提出一个更窄的架构性贡献：一条受 DIO/ODI 启发的边界，用于区分智能体可用于推理的证据与有资格授权持久性身份变更变更的证据。

sents.en: Agentic ER enables iterative evidence acquisition and state updates, but an early identity hypothesis may influence later retrieval and create apparent confirmation.
sents.zh: 智能体化 ER 支持迭代式的证据获取与状态更新，但早期的身份假设可能会影响后续检索并造成表面上的确认。

sents.en: It proposes a narrower architectural contribution: a DIO/ODI-informed boundary between evidence available to an agent for reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize a persistent identity-changing mutation.
sents.zh: 它提出一个更窄的架构性贡献：一条受 DIO/ODI 启发的边界，用于区分智能体可用于推理的证据与有资格授权持久性身份变更变更的证据。

paragraphs.en: The proposed binding function translates selected distinctions in referential, semantic, temporal, and contextual reconstruction failures into domain-configured constraints for particular mutation classes. Under the stated contract, a protected candidate may be committed only when the relevant candidate graph passes those constraints on claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence, the operation matches its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. UNVERIFIED evidence is not positive authorization support unless separately promoted for the specific claim under the stated contract; insufficient support or unresolved material conflict leads to deferral rather than implicit permission.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的绑定函数将指称、语义、时间与上下文重构失败中被选定的区分转化为面向特定变异类别的领域配置约束。 在所述契约下，仅当相关候选图在针对特定声明且符合授权资格的证据上通过那些约束、操作符合其授权范围、且相关状态与策略版本保持有效时，受保护的候选才可被提交。 未经核实的证据除非在所述契约下针对特定声明被单独提升，否则不构成正向授权支持；支持不足或存在未解决的重大冲突时将导致延迟处理，而非隐式许可。

paragraphs.en: This property is conditional on the adequacy of the domain policy, the claim-specific evidence-promotion process, and enforcement of the commit boundary. The invariant summarizes the specified obligations; it is not offered as a stand-alone theorem of semantic correctness. The contribution is the explicit contract for claim-specific promotion, proposition coverage, conflict handling, scope, and version integrity, together with a proposed DIO/ODI-informed way to organize the relevant domain constraints. It is an abstract design claim, not an empirical result or a guarantee that the underlying evidence is true. The evaluation protocol is proposed future work. A dependency-aware information-flow layer that addresses the upstream hypothesis-conditioned feedback loop remains an explicit research direction beyond the present commit-boundary contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 该性质以领域策略的充分性、针对断言的证据提升流程，以及对提交边界的执行为条件。 该不变量概括了所规定的义务；它并未被当作一条独立成立的语义正确性定理提出。 本文的贡献在于为断言特定的提升、命题覆盖、冲突处理、范围以及版本完整性给出显式契约，并提出一种受 DIO/ODI 启发的方式来组织相关领域约束。 它是一个抽象的设计性主张，而非实证结果，也不是对底层证据为真的保证。 评估方案被列为拟开展的后续工作。 一个能应对上游假设条件化反馈回路的依赖感知信息流层，仍是超出当前提交边界贡献的明确研究方向。

paragraphs.en: This paper was developed through a human-led, model-assisted process of conceptual exploration, architectural formulation, source-oriented research, manuscript drafting, and adversarial review. The author supplied the DIO/ODI research context and directed the problem framing, made the consequential decision to focus the present contribution on a commit-boundary authorization guardrail, and kept broader dependency-aware control of the hypothesis-conditioned cascade as a direction for future research. The architecture and manuscript emerged through iterative interaction rather than from a single model-generated output.
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过一个以人为先导、模型为辅助的过程发展而成，该过程涵盖概念探索、架构制定、面向原始文献的研究、论文撰写以及对抗性审阅。 作者提供了 DIO/ODI 研究背景并主导了问题界定，做出了将本文贡献聚焦于提交边界授权护栏这一关键决策，并将对假设条件级联的更广泛的依赖感知控制保留为未来研究方向。 该架构与论文是通过迭代式交互逐步形成的，而非来自模型一次性生成的单一输出。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI systems contributed substantively, not only as language-editing tools. GPT-based systems supported later-stage synthesis, drafting, formalization, and revision of the architecture, interface contracts, algorithms, and prose. Claude contributed design criticism and adversarial review. Gemini was used during an earlier exploratory phase; material from that phase was subsequently reassessed rather than treated as authoritative. Perplexity supported source-oriented research, bibliographic checks, and targeted regression review, while Qwen and Kimi were used for adversarial critique of selected drafts. The roles and versions of the systems changed during development, and the work was not a controlled comparison of model capabilities. The manuscript underwent iterative, versioned revision, including reviews aimed at exposing counterexamples, unsupported novelty claims, citation problems, and inconsistencies between the stated invariant and its algorithmic realization.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式 AI 系统作出了实质性贡献，而不仅仅是作为语言润色工具。 基于 GPT 的系统支持了后期阶段架构、接口契约、算法与正文的综合、起草、形式化与修订。 Claude 提供了设计批评与对抗性审查。 Gemini 在早期探索阶段被使用；该阶段的材料随后经过了重新评估，而非被视为权威。 Perplexity 支持面向来源的研究、文献核查与针对性的回归审查，而 Qwen 和 Kimi 被用于对选定草稿的对抗性批评。 各系统的角色与版本在开发过程中有所变化，本工作并非对模型能力的受控比较。 手稿经历了迭代式、带版本记录的修订，包括旨在暴露反例、缺乏依据的新颖性声明、引用问题以及所述不变量与其算法实现之间不一致的评审。

paragraphs.en: Model outputs were treated as fallible proposals and critiques, not as evidence of system performance or as independent peer review. The author selected, rejected, and revised suggestions and remains responsible for the paper’s framing, design decisions, interpretations, claims, references, and final text. The author also retains responsibility for verifying retained factual claims and bibliographic details against their underlying sources. No empirical results are reported on the basis of model outputs; the evaluation protocol remains proposed future work. The paper is a model-assisted conceptual proposal developed under the author’s direction. Its stated properties remain conditional on the assumptions and limitations described above; it is neither implemented nor empirically validated.
paragraphs.zh: 模型输出被视为可能出错的建议和评论，而非系统性能的证据，也不是独立的同行评审。 作者选择、拒绝并修改了这些建议，并对论文的框架、设计决策、解释、主张、参考文献和最终文本承担全部责任。 作者还负责对照其底层来源核实所保留的事实性主张和参考文献细节。 未基于模型输出报告任何实证结果；评估方案仍属拟开展的未来工作。 本文是在作者指导下开发的模型辅助概念性提案。 其所述特性仍取决于上文所述的假设与限制；它既未被实现，也未经过实证验证。
